title: Dumcius drops 26 as Marijampoles SC cruise past Siauliai to clinch U19 Lithuanian Basketball League title
description: Marijampoles SC-Eurostandard claimed the U19 Lithuanian Basketball League championship on Saturday, overwhelming Siauliu KA "Saule" I-Å SG 95-76 in the final at their home arena on Gamyklu Street behind a devastating first-half performance. The hosts set the tone with a blistering opening quarter, racing to a 31-12 lead that effectively ended the contest before it had truly begun. A 28-19 second period extended the advantage to 59-31 at halftime â€” a 28-point cushion that gave Marijampole the freedom to manage the game through the second half. Meinardas Dumcius (190-G/F-2007) was magnificent in the championship game, finishing with 26 points on 8-of-16 from inside the arc and 1-of-3 from three, while converting 6-of-8 from the free-throw line.
